Blessed by the ancient Daeva <QK>Zumion</>, who was beloved by the gods, it bears an appearance resembling its creator.

It was entrusted with the task of testing those who seek to break the seal, releasing the relic's power only to those who prove themselves worthy.

A small, hidden cave in Tolbas Forest. Originally used by the Wind Breeze Merchants as an office and storage place for old documents, they were forced to abandon it as the Aullaeu's local influence grow. It is now maintained only for Kochi's personal use.

Upon learning of the Empyrean Lords' plans to raise the Bulwark, the Balaur attempted to attack Atreia through <QK>Nartis</> in the Abyss, only to be held back by <QK>Narun</> and his Eternal Legion.
This is the place where Narun's memories of escaping all his comrades and facing the Balaur alone remain in the form of dream fragments.
A hatchery and training ground for Dratona, a new kind of Balaur born in Atreia. Inherently fragile, they are often treated as expendable.
Ruins of the Ancient City of Ru

A cave deep within the secluded reaches of Cantas Valley, chosen by the Lupyllini to make their nests. Long used by bandits from nearby mountains to hide their looted treasures, the presence of Lupyllini has made it all but impossible for humans to approach, leaving the treasures piled inside to gather dust with nobody to lay claim to them.

Once a paradise for spirits and animals living in harmony, the island's ecosystem is rapidly collapsing as a result of Poison Blood contamination. Spirit Guides have established a base in an area free of contamination and work tirelessly towards the restoration of the island.

A highland area connecting Verteron to Eltnen just before the Dartas Plains begin. Some grasslands remain in Eltnen, but the land is gradually becoming a desert and most remaining sources of water are contaminated.
Shugo from the Tsenka Merchants have set up a branch office in the highland to purify contaminated water and search for aquifers.
A sanctum where the Destruction Archons, sworn to Zikel, find their final rest. Known as the Warriors' Rest, this ancient site is rumored to safeguard relics connected to Zikel.
A research base where the Balaur store distorted and unstable Odylium.
An <QK>eastern camp</> base located in the east of Chaotic Middle Reshanta.
A forest on the outskirts of the Aullaeu Village. It is home to Holyaul, a former ritualist of the Urugugu tribe, and his followers, who were exiled by Aulamus.

A settlement founded by the Tsenka Merchants, one of the oldest and most influential merchant guilds in Elysea. In recent years, the guild has prospered under its new leader, Hoga, and the village has flourished alongside it.
Rumors persist that the Shugo merchants owe their prosperity beyond the Bulwark to secret dealings with the Balaur, though no proof has ever come to light.

The Abyss Rift Zone—an Abyss within the Abyss, accessible only through rifts that open periodically.

Here, too, the Balaur run rampant, their attentions directed squarely at the Daeva. But the conflicts that raged in Reshanta showed no signs of fading in the new realm, only intensifying further.
Even in the Abyss beyond the dark, peril-filled rifts, the Daeva of each dimension clashed fiercely, continuing their conflicts,
and even the mighty Balaur were relegated to little more than a means to prove one faction's superiority over the other.
To Daeva who plunged fearlessly into the Abyss Rift Zone,
even the mightiest Balaur were nothing more than prey worthy of their honor.

With the opening of each new rift,
Elyos and Asmodians alike rush in to form base camps from which they may continue waging all-out internecine war and hunting down Balaur.
A prayer hall within the Aullaeu Village, where a fanatical band of Aullaeu devoted to Ishtar is said to gather.
An area of old trees that twisted and mutated in order to survive in the Middle Abyss, where Odyle energy is scarce.
Forest Shade Execution Site Treasure Storage

A Shugo station located on the border of Tolbas Forest. While the workshop's main role is to craft and supply a variety of goods, its main product is a medicinal herb made from Biruta leaves. Biruta leaves are difficult to work with, so they chose to set up their workshop on the border, where the leaves are readily available.

Long ago, treasure hunters fled to an abandoned ruin to escape a Balaur assault. They perished after being trapped within, and lingered on as vengeful revenants. Driven mad, they came to regard the ancient tome within as a priceless treasure, and now serve as its guardians.
An outpost built by the Dawn Legion in Cantas Valley. The Dawn Legion is using the Cantas Valley's Odyle Collector to collect the scarce Odyle.
An area where the Balaur have concentrated their Drana cultivation. A huge Drana condensation root has small Drana trees and devices attached to it, the latter of which are maintained by workers.
A secret rendezvous point for the Daybreak Society. Once used to store totems, it has long sat abandoned. Broken totems lie scattered, coated in dust.

An elite Lepharist mage.
Leader of all the Lepharists dispatched to the Ruberein Highland in order to find the Artifact.
He has the ability to magically trace footsteps and has followed those traces to the Fountain of Life.

A forested area between Altgard Fortress and the Vaspelt Timberlands. Under the care of the Elim, it was once home to a variety of flora and fauna, but recent raids by the Blood Blades have left it in ruins.
The southernmost region of Chaotic Middle Reshanta. Corroded metal wreckage scattered around the site denotes the presence of a fortress in the past.

A plain containing abundant vegetation due to the influence of the coastal and volcanic areas, despite being adjacent to the snowfield. The Balaur have set up outposts and Fafnium here in order to take over.

A wide, sprawling region further north past the Eltnen Barrier Tower. The land is contains both mountains and plains, with grasslands remaining farther out from the center. The coast and sea can be seen at the very end.
A hidden treasure vault beneath Idun's Lake once used by pirates to stash their plunder. After its discovery, the Blades seized the cache and placed it under the care of Custodian Chakkerman.

This rest stop was once a shelter for pilgrims visiting Ardus Shrine. Long abandoned, all that remains now are old, broken garden ornaments and stone chairs covered in moss. Although it has lost much of its former majesty, its spring all dried up, it is still a place where Daeva can stay for a while.
A cave full of Dratona eggs. The adult Dratona Baratuna vigilantly guards the eggs.
A place where the Fang Legion, who had infiltrated the Sanctum Outpost, hides from the Balaur's eyes.

A large square in front of the Impetusium. Its structures have been destroyed, with only a few traces of stairs and columns remaining, and it is now occupied by Balaur working hard to find a way to penetrate the Blood Barrier. Balaur camps and sabotage devices are dotted all over.

The former deputy leader of the Dawn Legion.

Perion vanished while fighting alongside the legion deployed to Verteron during the <QK>Nahid Fortress Conquest War</>. Presumed to have perished within the fortress laboratories, he was eventually discovered in a coastal cave, transformed into a Sura while still clinging to the necklace of his beloved, Hithanya.

A base of the Quai Merchant Guild, who once dominated Altgard's commerce until they were ousted by the Steel Hammer Merchants and forced to move to their current location. Baba, the head of this branch, is looking for a way to regain the Guild's footing by helping Nemon.
